image_description: A close-up, slightly angled shot of a printed paper menu lying on a textured beige surface. The menu features Japanese text organized in columns with red and black ink. There are section headers in red boxes and lists of items with prices. A small yellow sticker or label is visible on the right side of the background.

artifact_observations.location: Throughout the body of the menu
artifact_observations.reasoning: The primary function of a menu is readable text. The generated text is hallucinated gibberish that mimics character shapes but is completely illegible. This is a severe structural failure for this specific class.

artifact_observations.location: Edges of text lines and red header boxes
artifact_observations.reasoning: The edges of the printed elements bleed into the paper texture slightly, lacking the sharp contrast of real ink on paper. There is a general softness/motion blur effect that feels artificial.
The shadow cast by the menu onto the table is diffuse and lacks a clear contact point, making the menu look slightly floating or pasted on.
